snippet.title: Tailgate Demo Announcement Trailer 2026
snippet.description:
Tailgate Demo is going live on August 17, 2026.
Here's an updated trailer for the upcoming demo!

In the demo you will get a bite at a large portion of the game's first chapter "Sniff around and find out", a 20–40 minutes of gameplay.

About Tailgate:
Hyde, an aging labrador retriever, wakes up and realizes that Derek, his beloved Human has disappeared. The doggo reluctantly leaves the house to investigate, only to find himself in the middle of an ancient dog prophecy.

Wishlist Tailgate on Steam
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3046820/Tailgate
